# Sutcliffe Trading

Sutcliffe Trading is a New Zealand timber merchant established in 1988. The company supplies New Zealand-grown Radiata Pine through established sawmill and manufacturing relationships.

## Core product groups
- Manufacturing timber: feedstock for wood processors and timber manufacturers.
- Building and construction timber: structural, building, finishing and specialist construction products.
- Outdoor and landscaping timber: treated and purpose-made timber for fencing, retaining, decking and landscaping.
- Dunnage: timber for freight, shipping, load support and industrial transport.

## Service area
New Zealand, with nationwide timber supply.
